skill.summary: Helps match reading speed to purpose, difficulty, and retention needs instead of chasing speed alone.

latestVersion.changelog:
Speed Reading Calibrator v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a skill to help users calibrate their reading speed based on material type, purpose, difficulty, and retention needs.
- Guides users through a workflow prioritizing comprehension, matching pace to purpose, and including measurable comprehension checks.
- Provides clear output: purpose-speed match, pacing modes, comprehension checks, practice plan, and advice on when to slow down.
- Emphasizes personal responsibility, safety, and avoids unrealistic or prescriptive reading speed promises.
- Requires user-supplied reading material/goals and works within reflectively assistive boundaries.
